bank_name: AETS Part One 听力理解题库
schema_note: 每套题(set)含若干听力材料组(group)；每组一段对话(dialogue, P=飞行员 C=管制员)和1-4道题(questions)；answer 为正确选项字母；audio_* 为配套音频的规划路径（生成后按此命名）。
exam_note: 问题念完后5秒作答，听力只播放一遍（think_time_sec=5）。

paper_rules.说明: 组卷规则：不是150题混抽15题，而是分层随机。
paper_rules.q1_5: 从全部套卷的 slot=q1_5 组中（每套5组，共50组短对话，每组1题）完全随机抽5组，依次作为新卷 Q1-Q5。
paper_rules.q6_8: 从 slot=q6_8 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q6-Q8，不可拆分；可与其他组来自不同套卷。
paper_rules.q9_12: 从 slot=q9_12 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+4题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q9-Q12，不可拆分。
paper_rules.q13_15: 从 slot=q13_15 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q13-Q15，不可拆分。

sets.title: AETS test simulation 10
sets.directions: In this part, you are going to hear a dialogue or exchange, after the exchange, there will be a question. After each question, you have 5 seconds to think and choose the correct answer. You will hear each question only once.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Delivery, CES2519, our CTOT is 25, request start-up.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES2519, Delivery, start-up approved, temperature 2 degrees.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Start-up approved, CES2519.

questions.question: What does CES2519 request?
questions.explanation: 飞行员首句即说 'our CTOT is 25, request start-up'，明确请求的是开车（发动机启动），管制员也回复 'start-up approved'，故选 C。加油、推出和除冰均未提及。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3377, Wuhan Ground, taxi via M and K3, hold position at K3 for 2 minutes due to snow removal ahead, then via T to holding point of RWY36R.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Hold at K3, then via T to holding point RWY36R, CSN3377.

questions.question: Why must CSN3377 hold at K3?
questions.explanation: 管制员指令 'hold position at K3 for 2 minutes due to snow removal ahead'，说明等待原因是前方正在进行除雪作业，故选 C。除冰（de-icing）是针对航空器的作业，与 snow removal 不同。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CSN6604, a passenger had a panic attack and tried to open the emergency exit, the crew has restrained him, request security on arrival.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN6604, Wuhan Approach, roger PANPAN, security will meet you at the stand.

questions.question: Why is CSN6604 making an urgency call?

options.A: Because a passenger had a heart attack.
options.B: Because a passenger tried to open the emergency exit.
options.C: Because a passenger is giving birth.
options.D: Because a passenger refused to wear a seatbelt.

questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 'a passenger had a panic attack and tried to open the emergency exit'，即一名乘客惊恐发作并试图打开应急舱门，因此发出 PANPAN 紧急呼叫，故选 B。选项 A 把 panic attack 误作 heart attack。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN8802, Wuhan Approach, descend to 2400m on QNH1013, follow WHA-02A Arrival, Info Q.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Descend to 2400m on QNH1031, WHA-02A Arrival, Info Q, CSN8802.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN8802, negative, QNH 1013.

questions.question: What did the controller correct in the readback?
questions.explanation: 飞行员复诵时将 QNH 读成 1031，管制员纠正 'negative, QNH 1013'，被纠正的是气压修正值 QNH，故选 C。高度 2400m、进场程序 WHA-02A 和信息 Q 的复诵均正确。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Control, CCA4409, we can see a balloon at 1 o'clock, about 10nm, slightly above us.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA4409, roger, it's a weather balloon, maintain present level, report passing it.

questions.question: What did the crew of CCA4409 see?
questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 'we can see a balloon at 1 o'clock, about 10nm, slightly above us'，看到的是气球，管制员随后确认是 weather balloon，故选 D。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CES3350, ready.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES3350, cleared for takeoff, RWY36L, surface wind 010 degrees 8m/s gusting to 16m/s, after airborne, contact Departure on 120.6.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared for takeoff, Departure 120.6, CES3350.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CES3350, 500m climbing. We have an electrical burning smell in the cockpit, request return to land.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES3350, roger, turn right heading 060, descend to 900m, do you need any assistance?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Turn right heading 060, descend to 900m, request fire service upon landing, CES3350.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: Roger, CES3350, fire service will be ready. Contact Approach 126.8.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach 126.8, thanks, CES3350.

questions.question: What was the wind condition when CES3350 took off?
questions.explanation: 起飞许可中风况为 'surface wind 010 degrees 8m/s gusting to 16m/s'，阵风达 16m/s，属于阵风天气（gusty wind），故选 A。

questions.question: What problem does CES3350 have?

options.B: A burning smell in the cockpit.

questions.explanation: 飞行员爬升至 500m 时报告 'We have an electrical burning smell in the cockpit'，即驾驶舱内闻到电气烧焦味，故选 B。注意是 cockpit 而非 cabin，也未报告发动机起火。

questions.question: Which of the following statements is NOT true?

options.D: The smell was in the cabin.

questions.explanation: 对话中烧焦味位于 cockpit（驾驶舱），而非 cabin（客舱），故 D 项说法不正确，选 D。飞机刚起飞（500m climbing）、闻到焦味、请求返场均与原文一致。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3319, Wuhan Control, due traffic, offset 4nm right of track, expect rejoin the route at OBLIK.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, offset 4nm right of track, CSN3319.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Control, CSN3319, we have weather indication 35nm ahead of us, request deviate to the right for 18nm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3319, negative due to arrival flow from the south, can you accept deviation to the left?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Affirm, we need a heading of 350 for 20nm, CSN3319.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3319, turn left heading 350, report clear of weather.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Left heading 350, wilco, CSN3319.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Control, CSN3319, we have severe airframe icing, we are emergency descending to 4200m.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3319, Wuhan Control, roger MAYDAY, report reaching. Break Break. All stations, Wuhan Control, emergency descent between DA and XS, all aircraft below 6900m, leave the route to the east.

questions.question: How did the pilot of CSN3319 plan to avoid the weather?
questions.explanation: 飞行员发现天气后请求 'request deviate to the right for 18nm'，即计划向右偏航 18 海里绕飞，故选 B。35nm 是天气的距离，20nm 向左是被拒后的替代方案，均非最初的计划。

questions.question: Why was the right deviation not approved?

options.A: Because of the arrival traffic flow.

questions.explanation: 管制员拒绝右偏的理由是 'negative due to arrival flow from the south'，即受南方进港流量限制，故选 A。军航活动、危险区、禁区均未提及。

questions.question: What happened to CSN3319?
questions.explanation: 飞行员发出 MAYDAY 并报告 'we have severe airframe icing'，即遭遇严重机体结冰，故选 A。

questions.question: Where is CSN3319 when it started emergency descent?
questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 'we are emergency descending to 4200m'，管制员随后通报 'emergency descent between DA and XS'，即飞机在 DA 与 XS 之间紧急下降至 4200m，故选 D。6900m 是要求其他飞机避让的高度界限，不是该机位置高度。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Wuhan Tower, AFR889, 10nm final, established ILS, RWY36R.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: AFR889, Wuhan Tower, continue approach, reduce speed to 145kts.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Continue approach, speed 145kts, AFR889.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: AFR889, Tower, cleared to land, RWY36R, wind 340, 7m/s, gusting up to 17m/s. QNH1004.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared to land, RWY36R, QNH1004, AFR889.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, AFR889, we had an engine surge during the landing roll, we have shut down the engine and stopped on the runway. Unable to vacate, request a tug and a fire check.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: AFR889, roger, tug and fire service are on the way. Break Break. CSN6617, go around, I say again, go around, runway occupied.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Going around, CSN6617.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CSN6617, we will hold for 15 minutes, request the latest weather and the runway in use.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN6617, roger, contact Wuhan Approach on 124.2.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach 124.2, CSN6617.

questions.question: Why did AFR889 stop on the runway?

options.A: A tire burst on the nose gear.
options.B: An engine surged during landing roll and was shut down.

questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 'we had an engine surge during the landing roll, we have shut down the engine and stopped on the runway'，即着陆滑跑中发动机喘振并关车停在跑道上，故选 B。

questions.question: What was the consequence of AFR889's problem?

options.A: The aircraft skidded off the runway.
options.D: The fire spread to the wing.

questions.explanation: AFR889 停在跑道上 'Unable to vacate'，管制员随即指挥 CSN6617 'go around, runway occupied'，说明跑道被占用堵塞，故选 C。

questions.question: What did CSN6617 request after the go-around?

options.A: To hold for 15 minutes and get a weather update.

questions.explanation: 复飞后 CSN6617 说 'we will hold for 15 minutes, request the latest weather and the runway in use'，即请求等待 15 分钟并获取最新天气和在用跑道，故选 A。
